fields.value: Unify disk-backed session journal and SSH program installer

Problem: After PR #151 (`5e038f`), one domain concept — an owned machine's disk-backed session folder (`~/.etude/sessions/<id>/`) — has three separate implementations, and one SSH program install handshake has two copies:
- Three journal owners (`src/etude/launch/ssh_boot.py`, `src/etude/launch/storage/disk.py` `DirectoryJournal`, and `src/etude/launch/worker/remote.py`) with live behavioral drifts:
  1. `bootstrap.log`: 1 MB cap + `closed=False` in `ssh_boot.py` vs unbounded + `closed=(ended is not None)` in `DirectoryJournal`.
  2. `usage.jsonl`: `errors="replace"` in `ssh_boot.py` vs strict `read_text()` in `DirectoryJournal`.
  3. `sources/*.tar`: atomic `.partial` + `os.replace` in `handle_add`/`DirectoryJournal` vs non-atomic `write_bytes` in `worker/remote.py`.
- Two exit-97 SSH program installers (`src/etude/launch/ssh.py` and `src/etude/launch/server.py`), plus warm `StartRequest` uploading ~1.17 MB without checking `<digest>/ready` first.
- `src/etude/launch/scheduler/loop.py` still checks `machine.kind == "ssh"` directly in Layer 3 instead of expressing pre-commit confirmation through `Execution`.

Outcome:
- One stdlib-only session-folder core used directly by both `DirectoryJournal` locally and `ssh_boot.py` over SSH, eliminating the three drifts by construction and making `StartRequest.files` staging atomic.
- One shared SSH program installer used by both `ssh.py` and `server.py`, checking `<digest>/ready` before shipping the archive on warm `StartRequest`.
- No `machine.kind == "ssh"` transport branches in `Scheduler`.

Done when:
- Local `DirectoryJournal` and remote `SSHJournal` share one stdlib session-folder implementation and pass parity tests on logs, usage parsing, atomic source staging, and full-disk refusals.
- Warm `StartRequest` skips the ~1.17 MB upload when `<digest>/ready` already exists (pinned in counting tests).
- `Scheduler` contains no `machine.kind == "ssh"` checks; `uv run pytest`, `uv run mypy`, `uv run ruff check .`, and `uv run ruff format --check .` pass.

Overlap & constraints:
- Builds on PR #151 (`5e038f`, touching `ssh_boot.py`, `ssh.py`, `storage/disk.py`, `worker/remote.py`, `server.py`, `scheduler/loop.py`), which already moved SSH session control to stdlib `ssh_boot.py` and added the 60 s refusal cooldown for post-claim `Refused` delivery.
- Keep all bootstrap/pre-install modules standard-library-only and out of the Vast/rental guardian archive (`provisioner/providers/package.py`).
